title: titleraw
description: Controls the text and behavior for screen titles using JSON messages.

player.title: player
player.description: A player name `string` or [`target selector`](https://learn.microsoft.com/minecraft/creator/documents/commandsintroduction#target-selectors) to identify the player.

titlelocation.title: titleLocation
titlelocation.description: The location where the raw title will display. Uses the `TitleRawSet` Enums `title`, `subtitle`, or `actionbar`.

raw_json_titletext.title: raw json titleText
raw_json_titletext.description: A JSON `string` for the raw title text.

fadein.title: fadeIn
fadein.description: The number of gameticks for the raw title to fade in. Default: `0`.

stay.title: stay
stay.description: The number of gameticks for the raw title to stay. Default: `0`.

fadeout.title: fadeOut
fadeout.description: The number of gameticks for the raw title to fade out. Default: `0`.
